title: Boris Vallejo
description: BORIS VALLEJO, the fantasy artist renowned for his Amazonian women and Herculean men, on a commisSion from the Coca-Cola Co. to do four promotional posters for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. His largest (front) is a collage of the heroes and Darth Vader, with cut-in scenes of action on Hoth and Dagobah. He also captures a spiritual Luke Skywalker (back) taking instruction from Yoda, the Jedi Master, in the steamy swamps of Dagobah.
